3. Scenery and landmark inventory

From js/circuits/scenery/singapore.js (1144 lines). 17 required: true items, 9 modelGroup calls.

  • Hero model groups: Marina Bay Sands (3 leaning towers + skypark, ~s 0.18 R), Fullerton Hotel, Anderson Bridge, Parliament House, Supreme Court (stone-fin block + saucer), St Andrew's Cathedral, Singapore Flyer, Merlion (with its own waterBand), pit wave-roof hospitality.
  • Landmark registry tests/data/landmarks/singapore.json lists only 4 ids (merlion, parliament-house, fullerton-hotel, anderson-bridge); Sands, Flyer, Supreme Court and St Andrew's are built but not registered.
  • Kit: race-control tower (frac 0.58 and a pit one at 0.999), pedestrian bridge (0.72) plus bayfront-pedestrian-link (0.445), portal beats sheares (0.085–0.115) and finish-underpass (0.925–0.985) built from overheadSpan.
  • Skyline: 48-instance far backdrop band, five cityFront() runs (both sides), six hand-placed CBD towers at 0.06, three towers 0.46–0.52, hotel boxes 0.39–0.43, dressingExclusions to stop the generic city pass doubling up.
  • Water: waterBand at 0.26–0.36, 0.80–0.90, two depth bands (0.20, 0.44), Merlion bay 0.545–0.615; six lit bumboats.
  • Furniture: palms (stations 0.50–0.575 L, 0.705–0.78 R), arm lamps, flood-mast ring (floodMastRing(38…)), grandstands 0.735/0.765/0.785/0.99, billboards 0.94–0.98 (neon), led hoardings, armco, chain-link, tecpro, truss gantry.

6. Code & scenery deep-dive

Files and frames

  • js/circuits/singapore.js (150 lines) is data only; scenery/singapore.js (1144 lines) is one lazy-loaded scenery(api) closure. The brief is docs/tracks/singapore.md.
  • Frames: startFrac 0, sceneryStartFrac 0.5075, sceneryCoordinates "racing", plus reverse and sceneryLapMirror. transformSceneryApi wraps every k-keyed helper as f(sceneryNode(k), -side) (comment at scenery lines 16-24), so authored fracs and sides are mirrored; K(s) is the sanctioned conversion. Raw anchor() against the kit needs kitNode(s) = (n - K(s)) % n with the opposite side (used for the pit beacon, ~line 719). turns/sectors are racing-lap fractions, hand-mirrored when reverse was added.
  • Authored vs racing positions: the brief's landmark fracs (Fullerton 0.55, Anderson 0.62, Flyer 0.86, Sands 0.18…) are authored-space values. I did not re-derive where each lands in racing space, so the report's "racing frac" captions refer only to the camera position.

Lighting (night lamps)

  • dressingExclusions has {kind:"lamps", s0:0, s1:1} (js/circuits/singapore.js:71), and build-props.js:2279 skips generic lamps where excluded, so the verge lamps in the frames are not the theme's lamp pass.
  • They are floodMastRing(38, {h:24, dist:11, cool:false, pool:true, arms:3}) (scenery/singapore.js:714): every(38 m) × both sides ⇒ roughly 129 stations × 2 ≈ 258 masts over 4906 m (my arithmetic, not a counted figure). Each mast registers one warm "halogen" lamp (identity.js:62-122) with radius capped at 110 m.
  • Pit-straight race-control tower, circuitKit.raceControl (0.58, 0.999), a cyan beacon cone and flat neon strips (addBox … NEON[1], five promenade strips at s 0.20/0.30/0.42/0.82/0.88) add emissive accents; hotel/CBD windows come from cityFront, tower, building with lit:true.

Bridges, tables

  • Overpasses: makePortal("sheares", 0.085, 0.115, {h:7.4}) and ("finish-underpass", 0.925, 0.985, {h:6.8}); three deck beats each via overheadSpan (piers come from the engine, line 41-45 comment says never hand-roll legs). Kit pedestrianBridge at 0.72 (clearance 7.2), bayfront-pedestrian-link at 0.445 (7.4). Anderson Bridge is a modelGroup (line 383), not a road bridge.
  • Terrain/width/elevation/banking tables (def): terrainOuter 48, four hwZones (control-index fracs 0.5890-0.6642, 0.1020-0.1774, 0.2341-0.2901, 0.3236-0.4067; hw 5.1-5.3), two elevations (±2.5 m, halfM 120 at 0.90/0.38), six bankZones (2.5-3°). Per js/track/CLAUDE.md, bank zones that sit more than 60 m from an apex are re-seated; the raw cl.bank array reads 0, so I did not measure the applied banking.
  • graph-parity not run: it needs BASE=<ref> and this branch has no js/ diff to compare.

Defects tied to code

  • Stepped bay edge: waterBand(s0, s1, side, gap0, gap1, cell, col, opts) (js/track/scenery/build-props.js:1047-1051) rasterises water into square cell-sized tiles (waterRaster then waterEmit). The circuit passes cell = 12 (scenery/singapore.js:988-989, 1015, 1056), so the boundary steps in 12 m squares. A smaller cell (min is 4) would soften it at higher vertex cost.
  • Cream plates: floodMast with pool:true (identity.js:94-97) adds a 7.5 × 0.18 × 7.5 m box in an unlit warm cream [0.82,0.78,0.62] at every mast foot. The circuit asks for pool:true at line 714; pool:false or a tod-gated colour is the fix. This explains the plates in nearly every frame, including under the masts at day. Palm plinths are separate (palm helper) and not traced.
  • Day-lit neon on water: bumboat windows (scenery/singapore.js:1127-1138) and the quay boxes (1017-1023) use fixed emissive-style colours; nothing there reads NIGHT, unlike floodMast which does (identity.js:70). Which of the two paints the coloured tiles in frame 27 is not confirmed.
  • Clip near frac 0.953: the pit-straight beacon addCone(out, vadd(a.c, a.u, 33.9), 2.2, 6, NEON[1]…) (about line 722) sits 0.06 m off a roof centre per its comment, so the severe addBox × addCone overlap (1.48 m, clip-audit) is more likely the kit tower versus a cityFront(0.955, 0.04, -1, 14, …) box; unconfirmed.
  • Brown terrain, fog wash: not traceable to a circuit line from this survey; see defects 2-3 below for the suspected files.

Real-world cross-check

I did not browse the web. Facts here are the circuit file's own citations: Pirelli and the National Library Board for anticlockwise running, Autosport for the 80 km/h pit limit (URL in js/circuits/singapore.js:7), Wikipedia for the Merlion's 8.6 m height and position (comment near scenery/singapore.js:1068), F1.com's landmark list. The 4.940 km / 62 laps figure is the source's claim, not re-verified. Estimates marked above are mine.

7. Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

  1. medium Bay water by day reads as a hard-edged navy sheet with glowing tiles. Frames 27, 44, 45 (orbit f33). The waterBand outline steps in square notches with brown terrain poking through, and flat magenta/cyan/amber rectangles sit on it unchanged in daylight. Suspect: waterBand(0.26, 0.36, …) at js/circuits/scenery/singapore.js:988 and the emissive quay/boat boxes around lines 1015–1025 and 1128–1141 (neon/window colours are not gated by time of day). Cause confirmed for the edge: waterBand rasterises 12 m cells (js/track/scenery/build-props.js:1047, §6). Fix: soften the band's edge (finer grid or terrainOuter-aware clipping) and drop or dim the neon tiles when tod != night. The rectangles' exact owner is unconfirmed.
  2. medium Night fog washes to a milky cream. Frame 84 (night fog f50) is far brighter than pal.fogColor [0.06,0.08,0.14] while frame 83 (f17) stays dark; flood pools light the haze. Mechanism is probably in the weather/fog blend in js/lighting/atmosphere.js (touched by the merged PR #1979) rather than the circuit; needs a lightState probe to confirm.
  3. medium Day and dusk terrain is brown mottled dirt, not concrete. Frames 25–36, 67–72. pal.grass/runoff are grey 0.25/0.30 and terrainMat: "CONCRETE" (js/circuits/singapore.js:29,104-105), but the baked pack tint under warm day light reads as desert. Check matTex A/B (__apex.matTex(0)) to see whether the pack layer or the palette is responsible.
  4. medium Severe clip, 1.48 m, addBox × addCone at racing frac 0.953. Baselined, so CI passes. Candidate: the pit race-control beacon cone (addCone(out, vadd(a.c, a.u, 33.9), 2.2, …), around line 722) against the tower roof or the cityFront(0.955, 0.04, -1, …) boxes; confirm with clip-audit output before editing.
  5. medium 125 palms, 10 backdrops and 1 building are dropped by the guard at build time (verify-track warning). Visible as bare verge on stretches where the explicit palm rows (lines ~1033–1043: 8 stations × 2 palms) do not reach. Raise the drop reasons from the guard log to see whether they are on-road or exclusion hits.
  6. low Gallery builder tooling gaps. (a) WEATHER_TAIL in tools/track/build-gallery.cjs lists dry|wet|rain|fog|overcast only, so all 8 storm frames (6 day, 2 night) are indexed with tod unknown, condition storm, and sector orbit-f00-day (measured in the scratch gallery build). (b) --out DIR as printed by --help is ignored; only --out=DIR is parsed (main(), line ~644), so the first build rewrote the tracked gallery/tracks/ (restored with git checkout, nothing committed). Result of the scratch build: 137 shots, 29 circuits; 84 of the 87 singapore entries are this survey (day/dry 12, night/dry 12, night/rain 12, dusk dry 6, dusk rain 6, day wet/rain/overcast/fog 6 each, night wet 2, night fog 2, storm 8 with tod unknown).
  7. low Oversized cream base plates under lamps and palms (visible in nearly every frame, e.g. 26, 27, 04) look like paper tiles by day. Cause: floodMast(… pool:true) adds a 7.5 m cream box at each mast foot (js/track/scenery/identity.js:94-97), requested at scenery/singapore.js:714; fix is pool:false or a night-only pool.
  8. low Brief/code drift. docs/tracks/singapore.md §3 puts the underpass at ~s 0.10 and Anderson at ~0.62; the measured dip/rise sit at racing 0.15 / 0.65 (elevations at control fracs 0.90 / 0.38, js/circuits/singapore.js:107-110). Also the header's "real 12 L / 7 R" disagrees with the measured 11 L / 8 R.
  9. low Landmark registry covers 4 of 9 hero groups (tests/data/landmarks/singapore.json); add Sands, Flyer, Supreme Court, St Andrew's if they should be gated.
  10. low Coplanar 241 m² pair at 3.4 mm gap (fights from 131 m): baselined shimmer risk while driving; a still frame cannot show it.

8. Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut: only 2 laps positions (0.17, 0.50) for night wet/storm/fog; no dusk eye/trackside; no storm eye/trackside; no dawn at all; no aerial or hero-landmark close-ups (Sands, Flyer, Merlion, Anderson bridge) — the six fixed orbit stations rarely frame them.
  • Frames are from software SwiftShader TLX only: not evidence for any real GPU, GLX or WGX.
  • Static frames cannot show z-fight shimmer; lamp firing at dusk/dawn not probed with lightState.
  • Raw cl.bank is 0, so banking could not be measured; T4/T5 and T10/T11 collapse onto one curvature peak in my ±10-node search, so whether they are two distinct apexes is unmeasured.
  • No real-world imagery was compared; source claims in §1 are the circuit file's own comments.
